answer.reason: The verses show Asaph appointed as a singer with cymbals and set as chief to minister before the ark.

clauses.english: was appointed with Heman and Ethan to sound with cymbals of brass
clauses.quote: Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass

clauses.english: was made chief of those who ministered before the ark of the LORD
clauses.quote: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah

doubts: Verses naming his sons or later descendants (1CH 25, 2CH 20:14, 2CH 29:13, 2CH 35:15, EZR, NEH) tell nothing of Asaph himself and were left out.
The psalm titles 'Psalm of Asaph' do not state a deed, so they were not used.
